jobs.title: Strategic Litigation Team Manager
jobs.reason: A "Manager" title at the Project/Regional Lead pay band, and a strategic-litigation lead role plainly requires senior experience and very likely a legal background the candidate lacks. The human-rights mission is a perfect interest match, but the level and qualification are hard mismatches.
jobs.salary: £52,088 plus up to 5% employee matched pension contribution

jobs.title: Fundraising Coordinator
jobs.reason: Entry-level (Coordinator band) and not disqualified, but it is a fundraising role drawing on dedicated fundraising and donor-management skills the candidate does not have, so paper fit is weak. The human-rights organisation is appealing, but the function sits well outside the candidate's research and policy strengths.
jobs.salary: £32,696 per annum plus up to 5% employee matched pension contribution

jobs.title: Investment Manager
jobs.reason: Not entry-level — a Manager title with a £90k–£150k salary clearly signals a senior investment professional with substantial relevant experience the candidate lacks. The role is also outside the candidate's research/policy field and skill set.

jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for "experts" to join an advisory committee — not a genuine paid entry-level role, and it explicitly seeks experienced practitioners/activists from specific regions (East Africa, Latin America, Southeast Asia), which the candidate is not. It reads as a voluntary/advisory expert appointment rather than a salaried vacancy, so it fails the genuine-paid-role gate despite the strong human-rights subject match.

jobs.title: Director
jobs.reason: This is the most senior executive post in the organisation — a Director leading three Deputy Directors with ultimate executive responsibility — far beyond an entry-level candidate with only student-assistant experience. The level is a hard mismatch despite the London location.

jobs.title: Fellow, Climate policy & development
jobs.reason: A "Fellow" role at a think-tank of CGD's standing is a senior research position requiring a strong track record (typically a PhD and/or several years of established expertise) in climate and development economics — well beyond the candidate's entry-level profile. The field is also outside the candidate's core interest zones.

jobs.title: Senior Fellow and Director Smart Buys Alliance
jobs.reason: A Senior Fellow and Director title is a clearly senior leadership role requiring many years of experience, and it is based in Washington DC with no London option, failing the London-only location filter. Both the level and location are hard disqualifiers.
